description: Tracked files that tools/tree_lint.py reports but that are live anyway: consumed by a name, a glob or a directory convention rather than by a path written in another tracked file, or left ambiguous only because a basename or stem several tracked files share cannot say which of them is named. Each entry is a path or a '*' pattern plus the one-line reason a reviewer can check. An allowlisted file is still printed by the report; the allowlist records a decision, it does not hide a file.

entries.reason: GitHub resolves review ownership by this exact filename; no tracked file is allowed to name it.
GitHub populates its issue-template chooser from this directory by convention, so neither the directory nor the filenames are written anywhere in the tree.
GitHub Copilot auto-loads this file by path for build/**/*.c; its zero-reference count is the expected consequence of that convention.
GitHub Actions runs a workflow by filename, so the file is live even though no tracked file spells its path.
The build entry point. It is invoked as `make` from outside the tree, and its basename is shared with every fixture Makefile, so no tracked file can name this one.
The repository front page, reached by the forge and by convention; its basename is shared with the fixture READMEs.
The repository's own GPL record, read by git and the forge by convention; its basename is shared with the vendored third_party licence copies.
Consumed by the unittest discovery glob `-p "test_*.py"` in the Makefile, the hosted workflow and CONTRIBUTING.md, which is what makes a test module live. No test module names another.
Python package marker: the package is imported by name (`from tools.nk_core import ...`), so the marker file itself is never written anywhere.
Each fixture's own documentation. The build or the runbook names the fixture directory, and a bare README.md token cannot say which fixture it means.
Built by the `make -C fixtures/psp_oracle` command documented in fixtures/psp_oracle/README.md; make finds the Makefile by directory convention.
Assembled by fixtures/psp_oracle/Makefile; its basename is shared with the fixtures/psp_phaseb copy of the same hand-written import shim.
Built by the `make -C fixtures/psp_threading_oracle` commands documented in fixtures/psp_threading_oracle/README.md; make finds the Makefile by directory convention.
